name: Conformance: Artifact Emit
description: RFC 0205 (register G2). One conformance.artifact.emit node produces one artifact and emits artifact.created naming it, so the suite can read it back through getArtifact (GET /runs/{runId}/artifacts/{artifactId}). Opt-in: a host advertises this fixture only when it implements getArtifact. See conformance/fixtures.md and v2-artifact-a2a-shape.test.ts.
